acceptanceCriteria: The script finds the go1.27.1 toolchain from `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go env GOROOT` and names no Homebrew path.
The descriptor snapshot tries GNU stat first, as V1-0430 did for the gate scripts, and the script passes in golang:1.27.1.
body: Found while running the rc.1 runbook on b967f6bb: tools/check-analyzer-go.sh (the focused, offline check for the standalone Go analyzer candidate) hard-codes go_root=/opt/homebrew/Cellar/go/1.27.0/libexec (line 16) rather than the repository's go1.27.1, and snapshots the go tool with BSD `stat -f '%d:%i:%p:%z:%m'` (lines 23 and 31); on GNU/Linux `stat -f` means --file-system, the V1-0430 defect class. It runs only on a macOS host with that exact Homebrew keg.
title: tools/check-analyzer-go.sh pins a Homebrew go 1.27.0 path and reads modes with BSD stat
